title: What is the difference between venomous and poisonous animals?
examples: Is a snake venomous or poisonous?
What makes a poison dart frog poisonous?
Can an animal be both venomous and poisonous?

explain.say: Both venomous and poisonous animals carry toxins, chemicals that harm the body. The difference is how the toxin gets into another animal.

explain.say: A venomous animal injects its toxin with fangs, a sting or spines. Snakes, spiders, scorpions, bees and jellyfish are venomous, and use venom to hunt, defend or both.

explain.say: A poisonous animal does not inject anything. Its toxin is in its skin or body, and harms an animal that touches or eats it. Poison dart frogs and pufferfish are poisonous.

explain.say: A handy rule: if it bites you and you get ill, it is venomous; if you bite it and get ill, it is poisonous. Poisonous animals are often brightly coloured as a warning.

faq.a: A venomous animal actively delivers toxin into another animal through a bite, sting or spine. Snakes, spiders, scorpions, bees, wasps, jellyfish, stonefish and male platypuses are all venomous.
asks: Is a snake venomous or poisonous?

faq.a: A poisonous animal carries toxin in its body or skin, which harms predators that touch or eat it. It has no way to inject it. Poison dart frogs, cane toads, pufferfish and monarch butterflies are poisonous.
asks: Is a frog venomous or poisonous?

faq.q: What makes a poison dart frog poisonous?
faq.a: Wild poison frogs get their toxins from the ants, mites and other small invertebrates they eat, and store them in their skin. Frogs raised in captivity on other food are not poisonous.
asks: Where do poison frogs get their poison?
Are pet poison dart frogs dangerous?

faq.q: Why are poisonous animals brightly coloured?
faq.a: Bright colours warn predators that the animal tastes bad or is dangerous. A predator that gets sick once remembers the colours and avoids them, which protects the whole species.
asks: Why are poison frogs so colourful?

faq.q: Can an animal be both venomous and poisonous?
faq.a: Yes, a few are. Some Asian keelback snakes have venom to bite with, and also store toad toxins from their food in glands in their neck, making them poisonous to predators that bite them.
asks: Which animal is venomous and poisonous?

facts: Venom is injected by a bite, sting or spine; poison harms only when touched or eaten.
Wild poison dart frogs get their skin toxins from their diet of small invertebrates.

quiz.say: A pufferfish is harmful to eat but has no fangs or sting. What is it?
quiz.why: Its toxin harms whoever eats it, and it cannot inject it, so it is poisonous.

wrong.1: Venomous animals inject toxins; a pufferfish cannot.
wrong.2: It does carry a deadly toxin, so it is poisonous.
